error_message: Google Drive rejected the generated portrait file reference because the file is unavailable for connector egress.
public_page_impact: No website file changed; no replacement was uploaded or published.
recovery_action: Stopped the denied connector-egress operation. Did not rename/copy/rehost/rewrite URLs/use another endpoint or reduce quality. Preserve the generated source mapping and retry only after the connector allows this exact file reference to egress through an authorized route.
notes: This BLOCKED_FILE_REFERENCE explicitly states that the generated file is unavailable for connector egress, so PORTRAIT_RECOVERY.md treats it as a binding access/security boundary rather than an ordinary stale file reference. Do not generate additional unsent portraits solely to work around this denial.
